_general: Scrub Desktop: local clipboard and document anonymisation. Keep placeholders and $1 substitutions intact. Native, concise UI language; no browser-extension terminology.
lang: BCP 47 language code of this file, e.g. de, pt-BR, zh-CN
dir: ltr, or rtl for right-to-left scripts
tier: Small badge: local processing, free of charge
tabScrub: Tab name: the anonymising step (verb/noun 'Scrub'); may keep the brand word
statusReady: Ready. Everything you review stays on this device.
scrubIntro: Patterns are suggestions. Check the result before you send it.
detectNameHeuristic: Optional detector that only suggests likely personal names for review
dictionaryIntro: Replace your names, organisations and project terms, including aliases.
aliasesLabel: Editable alternate names. No pipe-separated field.
sponsor: Link to support the developer on GitHub Sponsors; keep ♥ and →
confirmClear: Delete every session and saved mapping? This cannot be undone.
errCsvSize: CSV must be smaller than 5 MB.
welcomeDictionary: Third step: dictionary for client names.
trySample: Fill a realistic fictional sample and scrub it.
keepCategory: Keep all occurrences of all values in this category.
replaceItem: Reverse keep for all occurrences of this value.
restoreHelp: Explain unknown tokens and matching conversation mapping.
detectionHelp: Description of pattern switches and counts.
removeAlias: Accessible remove button; $1 is the alias.
sampleText: Fictional demo. Preserve the example email, phone and valid example IBAN.
shortcutLabel: Keyboard shortcuts — press a combination to record it
shortcutConflict: This shortcut is unavailable. Choose another combination.
waylandHelp: In GNOME or KDE Keyboard Settings, add custom shortcuts for these commands. Scrub briefly focuses its window to read the clipboard.
clipboardEmpty: Nothing to scrub — copy some text first.
noSensitive: No sensitive details found. Clipboard unchanged.
scrubbedNotice: Scrubbed $1 details. Paste it into your AI chat.
noPlaceholders: No Scrub placeholders in the clipboard.
storageError: Could not save local data. Check available disk space and permissions, then try again.
fileError: Could not read or save this file. Check the format and permissions.
genericError: The operation could not finish. Your input remains available; try again.
welcomeClipboard: Copy text, then press Ctrl+Alt+S to review it. Copy an AI answer and press Ctrl+Alt+R to restore it. Scrub stays in your system tray or menu bar.
privacyStorage: Mappings stay in memory unless you enable storage. Only the latest 10 conversations are retained. Clear all mappings to remove saved originals.
documentHint: Drop or choose a DOCX, TXT, CSV or Markdown file. Review replacements before saving a separate copy. Originals remain unchanged.
docxFields: Field codes not inspected: $1; visible results inspected.
docxTracked: Tracked changes are present; deleted text was inspected.
docxReviewers: Reviewer names retained: $1. Add them to the dictionary.
docxCleaned: Reviewer account or document creator metadata removed.
docxGeneral: Images, objects, field codes, custom XML, links and other metadata may still contain private data. Inspect before sharing.
docxRelationships: Relationship files with other uninspected content: $1
docxTargetsKept: $1 relationship targets still contain @. Inspect before sharing.
